concurrency_and_state: Sound.status (non-volatile static int) is read/written across main and background threads in Sound._load/_start/_stop with Thread.Sleep(5) spin-wait up to 500ms, while Sound.update() is empty so status is never reset inside Sound.cs.

Sound.player[] stores the same 'Audio Player 1' GameObject in every slot while __load calls AddComponent<AudioSource>() per slot; GetComponent<AudioSource>() in __start/__stop always returns the first AudioSource (SoundBGLoop).
mGraphics holds mutable static caches (cachedTextures, color1x1Cache) cleared wholesale on threshold (>400 / >300) via UnityEngine.Object.Destroy inside render calls.
mGraphics instance state (isClip, isTranslate, translateX/Y, translateXf/Yf, r/g/b/a) is mutated during OnGUI; reset() clears translateX/Y but does not reset translateXf/Yf or r/g/b/a.

SmallImage uses static arrays (imgbig, imgNew, smallImg) and MyVector (vt_images_watingDowload) mutated lazily during paint() via createImage() and periodically evicted every 1000 gameTicks in update().
cross_module_questions: Does Main.Update() or another controller poll Sound.status to execute __load/__start/__stop and reset status to 0, or are background-thread audio calls permanently stalling for 500ms?
Does GameCanvas or GameScr read mGraphics.getClipX/Y/Width/Height expecting actual setClip values rather than GameScr.cmx/cmy/gW/gH?
Is SmallImage.vt_images_watingDowload drained and downloaded by another module (e.g. Service/GameScr), and are server-sent SmallImage IDs bounded to prevent OOM when resizing imgNew?
Are all audio files /music/0..2 and /sound/0..38 present in Client Resources, since Sound.__load logs a warning when missing?

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Rms.loadRMS('NR_image') wrapped in DataInputStream without using/finally; close() skipped on read exception.
Rms.loadRMS and Rms.DeleteStorage for '<zoomLevel>Small<id>' invoked synchronously inside drawSmallImage()->createImage() on render path.

findings.impact: Every SFX start/stop targets SoundBGLoop's AudioSource (halting/playing on wrong channel), and background-thread sound calls block up to 500ms or fail while Sound.update() never drains Sound.status.
findings.root_cause: __load adds an AudioSource to 'Audio Player 1' and stores the same GameObject in player[pos]; GetComponent<AudioSource>() always returns component 0 (SoundBGLoop). Sound.update() is empty and status lacks synchronization.
findings.title: Sound.player[] aliases single GameObject causing wrong AudioSource control and thread spin-wait stalls

findings.impact: Multi-frame SmallImage sprites drawn from Big0-Big3 atlases render from texture origin (0, f*w) instead of their atlas coordinates smallImg[id][1..2], corrupting sprites.
findings.root_cause: drawSmallImage(mGraphics, id, f, x, y, w, h, ...) passes 0 instead of smallImg[id][1] as x0 and f*w without smallImg[id][2] offset as y0 to g.drawRegion.
findings.title: SmallImage 9-arg drawSmallImage ignores atlas x0/y0 offsets in smallImg[id]

findings.impact: Any non-iOS-AppStore caller of mSystem.getHeight(Image) receives image width instead of height; mSystem.arrayReplace silently leaves dest unmodified.
findings.root_cause: getHeight returns img.getWidth() when clientType != 5; arrayReplace copies into local array without assigning dest = array.
findings.title: mSystem.getHeight returns width and arrayReplace is a silent no-op

findings.impact: Horizontal/vertical drawLine, fillTrans, and fillArg render at zoomLevel^2 coordinates/sizes instead of zoomLevel; fillRect(6-arg) ignores alpha and forces 0.5f.
findings.root_cause: drawLine, fillTrans, and fillArg multiply coordinates/dimensions by zoomLevel before calling fillRect, which multiplies by zoomLevel again; fillRect(..., color, alpha) hardcodes alpha2 = 0.5f.
findings.title: Double zoomLevel scaling in mGraphics.drawLine/fillTrans/fillArg and ignored alpha in fillRect

findings.impact: blendColor produces completely wrong packed RGB ints; blend clamps [0..1] floats against 255f; getTimeCountDown overflows int if secondCount > 2,147,483s.
findings.root_cause: blendColor mixes [0..255] and [0..1] channels and combines them with '&' and '255 +' instead of '|'; blend clamps normalized Color floats to 255f; getTimeCountDown multiplies int secondCount * 1000 before long subtraction.
findings.title: Bitwise/scale errors in mGraphics.blendColor/blend and 32-bit int overflow in getTimeCountDown

findings.impact: Disk/RMS reads, Resources.Load, Texture2D creation, and GC allocations occur directly inside paint/OnGUI, causing frame hitches and memory churn.
findings.root_cause: drawSmallImage calls createImage synchronously during paint; drawLine(mGraphics,...) allocates MyVector and mLine objects per call; mSystem string formatters concatenate strings in loops; color1x1Cache destroys all cached Texture2Ds at >300 entries.
findings.title: Blocking I/O and per-frame GC allocations inside paint/render paths

findings.impact: If a malformed/huge SmallImage id is passed, imgNew resizes to new Small[id + 100], risking OutOfMemoryException or client crash; DataInputStream is unclosed on exception.
findings.root_cause: imgNew length check lacks an upper bound sanity cap; readImage closes DataInputStream inside try without finally/using.
findings.title: Unbounded SmallImage.imgNew resize and unclosed DataInputStream on exception

findings.impact: UI/settings/network mutations in SoundMn, hardcoded GameScr coupling in mGraphics.getClip*, and duplicate __drawRegion/_drawRegion implementations increase regression risk.
findings.root_cause: SoundMn owns Panel menus, RMS settings, Char aura flags, and Session_ME disconnect; mGraphics.getClipX/Y/W/H ignore clipX/Y/W/H and return GameScr.cmx/cmy/gW/gH; Sound.playSoundNatural checks SoundBGLoop instead of SoundWater and stopSoundNatural/sTopSoundBG lack null checks.
findings.title: Tight cross-module coupling in SoundMn/mGraphics and null/logic bugs in Sound channel guards

findings.impact: explode_2 plays EXPLODE_1 sound; charPunch/charRun divide static SoundMn.volume instead of local volumn parameter; Sound.stopAll flag is ignored by playback methods.
findings.root_cause: Copy-paste typo in explode_2 (EXPLODE_1) and charPunch/charRun (volume vs volumn); Sound.play/playSoundRun/playSoundNatural/playRainSound/playSoundBGLoop never check Sound.stopAll.
findings.title: Audio playback mismatches in SoundMn (explode_2, charPunch, charRun) and ignored Sound.stopAll flag

findings.impact: getWidthz/getHeightz add remainder modulo zoomLevel instead of ceiling division, overestimating logical viewport size by up to zoomLevel-1; translate(float,float) writes unused fields.
findings.root_cause: getWidthz uses width / zoomLevel + width % zoomLevel; mGraphics.translate(float,float) modifies translateXf/Yf which are never read by draw calls.
findings.title: MotherCanvas.getWidthz/getHeightz modulo math error and unused mGraphics.translate(float,float)

key_classes.name: mGraphics
key_classes.responsibility: Unity IMGUI/GL rendering wrapper managing zoomLevel scaling, translation, clipping, 1x1 color texture cache, and sprite region transforms.

key_classes.name: MotherCanvas
key_classes.responsibility: Top-level canvas adapter computing mGraphics.zoomLevel and forwarding scaled input/paint events to GameCanvas.

key_classes.name: mSystem
key_classes.responsibility: Platform/system utility helpers for time, formatting, byte/sbyte conversion, GC triggers, fly-text rendering, and connection state callbacks.

key_classes.name: MyAudioClip
key_classes.responsibility: Minimal wrapper around Unity AudioClip and Resources.Load with cached static AudioSource.PlayOneShot.

key_classes.name: SmallImage
key_classes.responsibility: Manages Big0-Big4 sprite atlases, NR_image metadata, dynamic Small icon loading/RMS caching, and periodic texture eviction.

key_classes.name: Sound
key_classes.responsibility: Low-level Unity AudioClip/AudioSource playback manager for BGM, rain, running, and SFX slots.

key_classes.name: SoundMn
key_classes.responsibility: High-level audio trigger facade mixed with PC/mobile option menus, RMS config persistence, and UI/session navigation helpers.

module_summary: Client core rendering, canvas scaling, system utilities, small sprite atlas management, and Unity audio subsystem across 7 files (3,683 lines). Critical issues include double zoomLevel scaling and broken blendColor math in mGraphics, ignored SmallImage atlas offsets in multi-frame drawSmallImage, blocking I/O and GC allocations during paint(), Sound.player[] aliasing a single GameObject/AudioSource with an empty Sound.update() spin-wait hazard, and UI/network God-class responsibilities in SoundMn.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: HatToolOption() dispatches hat display option toggle to server via Service.gI().sendOptHat(0).
backToRegister() closes active network session and switches UI to login/register screen.
